name: G_TerraMorph
description: apply an 8-bit stamp additively to terrain vertex heights (128 neutral; (hmax-hmin)/255 per level; skips underwater and off-grid vertices)
evidence: only callee of PF_TerraMorph; writes vertex array 0x2102e5c

name: G_FindMorphMap
description: find or load a morph stamp by name (64 per level, 8 bpp only; name gets .tga)
evidence: compares with records at 0x2103cd8; loads through 0x41c3d0

description: read an uncompressed TGA (types 1,2,3) into a record: width +0x80, height +0x84, bpp +0x88, pixels +0x90

name: G_WaterHeight

name: R_UpdateWaterChunk

name: R_DrawTerrainNode
